name: Sanrio x Labubu Collaboration
checklist: Authentic boxes have sharp, consistent print quality — blurred or off-color printing is a red flag.
Both POPMART and Sanrio branding must appear on authentic packaging.
Check the POPMART holographic authentication seal on the base of the figure.
Legitimate Labubu teeth are cleanly sculpted; bootlegs often have uneven or smeared teeth paint.
Purchase from authorized POPMART retailers or established secondary market platforms.
